account.notes: Law heading 'NIH Innovation Account, CURES Act' (P.L. 117-328, 118-47, 119-75); none in the FY2027 House bill (the CURES authorization ends with FY2026). An account of its own since v33: its figures were NIH-total component CURES ('contained') through v32 and were re-homed here with the same observation IDs. The NIH total (with CURES Act funding) adds it with NIH's other accounts; the Title II total subtracts it.
